युज् (य, ङ, औ) युज्यते 4.
d. To con-
fine the thoughts, to meditate.
(ध, ञ, औ, इर) युनक्ति, युक्ते 7.
c. To
mix, join. (कि) योजति, यति 1. 10.
a. To bind. योजयते 10.
a. To
blame. With अनु to inquire, re-
prove; with अभि^1 to utter, accuse;
with उत्^2 to strive; with उप^3 to seize, to
eat; with नि^4 to appoint, to join; with प्र^5 to
be fit, apply to, lend, strive; with वि^6
to separate, send; with सं^7 to unite;
with वि^8 and with नि^9 to appoint, expend,
send, force; with वि^10 and with प्र^11 to divide;
with सं^12 and आ to think profoundly.
